name: What questions should you ask a pool resurfacing contractor before hiring?

mainEntity.name: Which details matter most before signing a resurfacing contract in Los Angeles or Pasadena?
mainEntity.text: Which details matter most before signing a resurfacing contract in Los Angeles or Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor, the most useful questions focus on scope, process, and accountability. Ask whether the quote includes full removal or only a recoat, what repairs are expected, which finish brands or materials will be used, and how startup will be handled after refill. Also confirm whether tile, coping, drains, and plumbing are excluded or included. In a market like Los Angeles, where access and condition issues are common, a detailed inspection matters more than a generic price sheet. Homeowners should also ask how long the project will take, who will be on site, and what happens if hidden damage is discovered after draining. Warranty terms matter too, but only if the contractor explains what is covered and what voids coverage. A clear, specific answer to these questions usually tells you more than the advertised price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about surface prep, chip-out vs overlay, finish options, warranty terms, startup instructions, included repairs, and who handles cleanup and refilling. You should also confirm licensing, insurance, project timeline, and how change orders are priced. Clear answers to those items reveal whether the quote is complete or stripped down.
